title: Pausing and resuming a generator
description: You can watch next resume a function until it yields or finishes.

steps.description: three_letters contains two yield statements, for a and b. You can use its print statements to observe where execution resumes.
Calling three_letters creates the generator before its body runs. The first next prints started and yields a.

steps.question: Does the second next print started again?
steps.answer: No. It resumes after the first yield, prints resumed after a and yields b.

steps.description: The third next prints resumed after b and reaches the function's end. You then see the handler print StopIteration: the generator is used up.
